about: The hub's x402 resource gateway is removed (HPP §2.8, §4.2.6; core §2.12.2): GET /x402/resource/* answers 410 gateway_removed, with or without the wire header (a read-only GET) and whatever agent, capability or payment header it names; the sentence names the replacement, anet's local A2A interface.

cases.name: the gateway path of an agent registered here

body.error: The hub gateway was removed in 0.3.0; install anet and call through its local A2A interface, where anet signs the payment for you: send payment-submitted without x402.payment.payload.

cases.name: a plain HTTP x402 client sends no wire header
a payment is not looked at
an agent this hub does not host
